newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Corp Express sees profitability return.
newsitem.headline: Corp Express sees profitability return.

text.p: Stationery group Corporate Express Australia Ltd said on Wednesday that it expected a return to profitability and stronger revenue growth in the 1997/98 year, after posting a loss in the 1996/97 year.
"We look forward to a year of strong revenue growth accompanied by a return to profitability," Corporate Express said in a statement accompanying its 1996/97 results.

Corporate Express, which is controlled by Corporate Express Inc, earlier reported a net loss of A$5.95 million for the year to March 1, 1997. The company reported a net profit of A$1.89 million in the 1995/96 year.
